tasks.prompt: Make the component safe when user.name is missing. Preserve the exported component and use the fallback label Unknown.
Fix load_settings so callers receive defaults plus file overrides. Keep the function signature unchanged.

files.tests/test_settings.py:
import json
import pathlib
import sys
import tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from settings import load_settings

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', delete=False, encoding='utf-8') as handle:
    json.dump({'timeout': 30}, handle)
    path = handle.name
settings = load_settings(path)
assert settings == {'retries': 2, 'timeout': 30}
print('ok')
